topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, ain't that just dandy. Seems the whole joint’s going condo. Figures. Just when you get used to the creak in the floor and the leak in the sink, they want to wrap it all up in a neat little bow for the highest bidder. Well, I've seen this story before, and it always starts the same—folks get antsy, murmurings in the halls, whispers 'round the mailbox. But this time, I reckon it’s different. Fresh start, new faces. Maybe it'll bring in a bit of life, a little polish to these tired walls. Maybe it’s a chance to move on, to find a place that’s really yours, not just a rental. Beats living in the past.
